# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** 17 years old at the time of Anne's wedding  <sub>[v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002), [v4 c36 P4](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair child with long, sleek hazel-eyed curls that never get out of order and a straight nose. She has a "prunes and prisms" mouth and hazel eyes that are gentle and mild. She usually presents a very neat, starched, and ironed appearance.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Dora is extraordinarily well-behaved, quiet, prim, and proper. She is a methodical, obedient, and reliable girl who completes tasks with neatness and care. Extremely timid and easily frightened, she rarely causes trouble or acts out.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014), [v2 c10 P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033)_

- Careful gardening  <sub>[v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)</sub>

## History

Following the death of her sickly mother, six-year-old Dora and her twin brother Davy were taken in by Marilla Cuthbert at Green Gables. Unlike her mischief-making brother, Dora quickly proved to be exceptionally quiet and well-behaved, assisting with household tasks such as picking up chips, wiping dishes, and feeding chickens. She began attending Avonlea school alongside Davy, sitting with her classmates and behaving as a model pupil. When their uncle Richard Keith passed away, he left a fund in trust to secure their permanent home at Green Gables. As she grew older, Dora inherited Anne's former porch room and developed into a sensible, helpful teenager. By the age of seventeen, she began receiving courtships from Ralph Andrews.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007), [v4 c36 P3](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0003), [v4 c36 P5](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0005)_

- Daughter of Mary Keith and a father who died when she was a baby  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P7](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0007)</sub>
